name: Aik Mohabbat Aur
overview:
Aik Muhabbat Aur tells a simple but emotional love story between two people from different backgrounds. They meet by chance and slowly develop feelings for each other. However, family issues and past mistakes make their journey difficult. The drama shows how love requires patience and understanding.

As the story continues, both characters must make hard choices to protect their relationship. They face misunderstandings, pressure, and emotional moments. Each episode focuses on trust, sacrifice, and personal growth. Viewers can expect a heartfelt story that feels real and relatable.
